rows.title: Ask 'What are you importing?' before a notification is created
rows.gate: Look at the cross-service start before anything builds on it: the type page in the INS front door, how Live animals hands over to the animals frontend's start (today only a form post with its own request forgery token), how Germinal products hands over to the germinal set's start under /germinal-products before that set exists, and how the plants types hand over to the plants service. Then check that each hand-over takes its address from config and passes on the local stack, the CI stack and a CDP environment, including when the trader is not yet signed in to the receiving service. The re-selection row, template creation's type question and the germinal set's own start copy this pattern.

Animals admin uses the same name for the browser-facing Defra ID hostname rewrite as the other frontends

Frontend tests set config and serve Defra ID discovery instead of mocking their own modules
The animals and plants session cookie states its SameSite setting, and the config says which cookie it sets
The INS dashboard's functional tests reach its empty state and share their helpers

Animals frontend tidy: one shape guard for the session adapters, comments that say what code does, and a current Lighthouse doc
Animals controller tests seed state through named helpers instead of driveHandler's long options list
The plants e2e tests and page objects read without narration
Save and return on the plants consignor and place of destination pages makes the same checks as Save and continue
The workspace docs and INS spec describe the type question's links and the service navigation
Animals admin passes its security audit
Animals admin keeps its Defra ID connections open between sign-in calls, as the other frontends now do
The INS type question offers no Germinal products choice while the animals service has no germinal products start page
